cover.title: Ticket management system for service and repair companies
cover.subtitle: All tickets, technicians, warehouse and payments — in one place. Less confusion, faster replies to customers, easier growth.

items.title: Tickets get lost
items.text: Customer requests stay in chats, notebooks and spreadsheets. While you search for a number, the client has already gone elsewhere.

items.title: Schedule chaos
items.text: Technicians run late, mix up addresses or sit idle while the dispatcher manually coordinates the day.

items.title: Unknown warehouse stock
items.text: Unclear what parts are available and what is missing. That leads to failed visits and lost revenue.

items.title: Hard to track money
items.text: Difficult to see who earned how much, what clients paid and what the real profit is.

items.title: Clients are forgotten
items.text: No reminders for planned maintenance. Regular clients leave because nobody followed up in time.

items.title: Team is out of sync
items.text: Technicians, dispatcher and office work in different places. Tasks get duplicated and time is wasted.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: A clear path from request to go-live — without extra bureaucracy.

steps.title: Submit a request
steps.text: Briefly tell us about your company and industry — we will get in touch and agree on a convenient time.

steps.title: Review processes on a demo call
steps.text: We show the system on your scenarios and agree which modules you need at the start.

steps.title: Configure and migrate data
steps.text: We set up roles, statuses and forms, and migrate your client base to fit your process.

steps.title: Launch and train the team
steps.text: We train the administrator and technicians and support you through the first weeks.

items.title: Ready CRM for service work
items.text: Tickets, technicians, planned maintenance, warehouse, workshop, payment close-out and analytics — already in one system.

items.title: Built around your process
items.text: We enable the modules you need, remove extras, and tune fields, statuses, roles and print forms for your business.

items.title: Roles that match real work
items.text: Administrator, manager, staff and partner technicians — each with their own permissions and screen.

items.title: Tickets from creation to act
items.text: Statuses, priorities, technician assignment, comments, photos, parts and a public act for the client without CRM login.

items.title: Maps and routes
items.text: Yandex Maps for the office, daily route for the technician, stop order optimization and jump to 2GIS.

items.title: Planned maintenance
items.text: Maintenance by partners and sites: monthly progress, notes, PDF acts and quick conversion of a breakdown into a repair ticket.

items.title: Warehouse and “In service”
items.text: Stock levels and parts write-off into a ticket, workshop equipment tracking, photos and return to the client.

items.title: Money and technician KPIs
items.text: Income, expense, profit, technician and cash share on close-out. Summary: taken, closed, earned.

items.title: Analytics for management
items.text: KPIs for tickets, overdue work, revenue and profit. Status trends and technician performance.

items.title: Growth after launch
items.text: Custom features, new reports and integrations, ongoing support and deployment on your infrastructure.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Short answers before the demo call — no empty promises.

items.question: Do we need our own server?
items.answer: Not necessarily. You can deploy on your own server or use a cloud option. Cloud hosting, if you do not have a server, is billed separately.

items.question: What happens to our data if we stop working together?
items.answer: The data belongs to you. On request we will export the database in an agreed format so you can continue outside Nexora. Transfer details are fixed at launch.

items.question: How long does implementation take?
items.answer: A typical go-live takes from 2 weeks: demo call, module setup, data migration and team training. Timing depends on module scope and how ready your source data is.

items.question: Can we start with a small module set and add more later?
items.answer: Yes. Many teams start with the basics, then add planned maintenance, warehouse or analytics once the process is stable in the system.

items.question: How does support work after launch?
items.answer: Implementation includes support at the start. Then annual support: from 130 000₸/year for Start and from 250 000₸/year for Business. It covers updates, help with day-to-day questions and access to new modules.

privacy.metaDescription: How Nexora Systems collects, stores and protects personal data of clients and website visitors. Clear rules, your rights and operator contacts.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We treat your data carefully. Below are simple rules: what we collect, why and how we protect it.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.text: The data operator is IE Nexora (Kazakhstan). Contact: Karabek Asanali Kairatuly, phone +7 775 000 21 75, website nexorasystems.kz.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
sections.text: Company name, industry and phone number you leave in a demo request. Technical website data: IP address, browser type, pages viewed — only to keep the service stable.

sections.title: 3. Why we need it
sections.text: To contact you about your request, show the system, answer questions and improve the website. We do not use data for spam and do not sell it to third parties.

sections.title: 4. How we store and protect it
sections.text: Data is stored on secured servers. Access is limited to employees who need it for their work. We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards.

sections.title: 5. Who we may share it with
sections.text: Only if required by the law of the Republic of Kazakhstan, or if you asked us to. With processing partners — only to the extent needed to run the website and contact you.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep it
sections.text: Website requests — while correspondence continues and for a reasonable period after, then we delete or anonymize them. The period can be shortened at your request unless the law requires otherwise.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.text: You may request access to your data, correction, deletion or restriction of processing. Write or call us — we will respond within a reasonable time.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and analytics
sections.text: The site may use necessary cookies for pages to work. If we enable analytics, it helps us understand which sections are useful. You can limit cookies in browser settings.

sections.title: 9. Policy changes
sections.text: We may update this text. The current version is always on this page. The update date is shown above.
